critiques.comment: While the idea of adaptive route optimization is intriguing and well-integrated with the existing cell-graph architecture, its true impact on gameplay will depend on how noticeably and meaningfully the fleet's adaptations affect the player's experience.

While the core idea of adaptive routing isn't groundbreaking, leveraging the cell-graph architecture *with* machine learning is a clever approach that promises genuinely interesting emergent gameplay, though the feasibility relies heavily on successful ML integration.

A vague "machine learning makes routes better" pitch that name-drops opcodes and cell-graph architecture without explaining how adaptation actually manifests as player-facing decisions, making it more buzzword than mechanic.
